name: copy
description: Two overlapping rounded pages with a distinct foreground sheet.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested greater separation and the standard Camera/Folder main-body corner roundness. Both page centerlines use radius 3.25 with unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke and .85 round caps. Rear page centerline bounds are 2.85..15.45; front page centerline bounds are 8.55..21.15 on both axes. The offset is 5.70, producing a 4.00-unit clear straight gap between the exposed parallel borders (previously 2.80). Combined visible bounds are 2..22 on both axes, with balanced 2px artboard margins. The partial rear path terminates inside the foreground stroke so hidden edges do not appear. Filled uses the exact Outline exterior: outer corner radius 4.10, rear-band inner radius 2.40 and .85 end caps. Its front page is solid, with no added enclosing box or artificial hole. Position and visible exterior match between styles at native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
